record.question: The Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) comprises,
options: India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Bhutan, Nepal and Thailand
India, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Bhutan, Nepal and Thailand
India, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Myanmar, Bhutan, Nepal and Thailand
India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Bhutan, Nepal and China
record.explanation: Answer A: India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Bhutan, Nepal and Thailand. BIMSTEC's seven members are Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Thailand. Its own history records the admissions bringing membership to seven by 2004. Only option A contains the full correct set. Reference: https://www.bimstec.org/history. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
